text:
Ethan: FYI: new reranker int8 bring-up shows split metrics on the long-tail holdout. NDCG@10 +0.1%, but MRR@10 -5.6%. run id run/2026-06-01/07
Zara: raw numbers?
Ethan: float MRR=0.389 -> int8 MRR=0.367; NDCG float=0.621 -> int8=0.622
Marta: long-tail specifically? which slice?
Ethan: yes 10% lowest-frequency queries. I inspected candidates: a lot of HTML-escaped fragments and mixed-case tags in snippet fields. sample: "How to fix <iframe> resize" vs "How to fix <iframe> resize"
Zara: HTML-escapes change tokenization. On short queries top1 can flip easily. Also PTQ config?
Ethan: PTQ: int8_dynamic, per_channel=false, calib=2k, seed=21
Marta: two quick probes: A) unescape HTML in serializer -> MRR up ~2.3% on slice. B) per_channel=true -> +1.1%. Combined -> +3.4% but still below float.
Zara: could be dataset selection bias: long-tail queries have more noisy snippets; try a cleaning step that strips markup and normalizes casing for snippet field only and rerun calibration with calibr_samples=8192.
Ethan: opening bench diff and small repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench/pull/840
ci-bot: shadowbench queued sb-840 (10k long-tail) est 1.8h
Marta: local 1k probe with cleaning + per_channel + more calib -> MRR=0.394 (beats float).
Zara: great. Action items: 1) add "snippet_clean" stage to serializer that unescapes HTML + collapse tags, 2) default per_channel PTQ for rerankers, 3) add a long-tail slice check to rerank gating (MRR variance <2%).
Ethan: PR #840 opened with serializer change + bench regen + unit tests for common HTML entities.
ci-bot: sb-840 complete: patched vs baseline on long-tail slice -> NDCG@10 +0.18%, MRR@10 +5.0% (patched wins)
Marta: recommend merging after perf sign-off. Also add a note in onboarding docs: always clean snippet/html noise before curation for rerank evals.
Ethan: will follow up. Thanks!
